parameters{
	DestinationTableInv as string (),
	DestinationTableShp as string (),
	DestinationTableTax as string (),
	FileArchiveDir as string (),
	FileLocalDir as string (),
	FileLocationARPdf as string (),
	FileLocationARPdfRename as string (),
	FileName as string (),
	ForEachDBConnStr as string (),
	ForEachDBConnStrList as string (),
	ForEachSourceSystemId as integer (),
	PackageExecutionID as integer (),
	QueryReadFromSourcecsvAG as string (),
	QueryReadFromSourceInv as string (),
	QueryReadFromSourceShp as string (),
	QueryReadFromSourceTax as string (),
	QueryReportGenCheck as string (),
	RowsDeleted as integer (),
	RowsDiscarded as integer (),
	RowsInserted as integer (),
	RowsNotWrittenError as integer (),
	RowsReadError as integer (),
	RowsReadNoError as integer (),
	RowsUpdated as integer (),

	FeedFolderExternal as string (),

source(output(
		ShipmentNumber as integer,
		ShipmentDate as timestamp,
		Note as string,
		InvoiceNumber as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select getdate() t',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> ReadfromSource
ReadfromSource derive(ShipmentNumber = ShipmentNumber) ~> PlaceHolderRowsReadNoError
PlaceHolderRowsReadNoError derive(ETLCreateDate = $startTime,
		ETLExecutionID = $PackageExecutionID,
		SourceSystemId = (SHORT) $ForEachSourceSystemId,
		InvoiceSK = toString((toString($ForEachSourceSystemId) + '-' + InvoiceNumber))) ~> DeriveAuditandOtherColumns
DeriveAuditandOtherColumns sink(input(
		ETLCreateDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		InvoiceSK as string,
		ShipmentDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ShipmentNumber as integer,
		Note as string,
		ETLExecutionID as long,
		InvoiceNumber as string,
		SourceSystemId as long
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		ETLCreateDate,
		InvoiceSK,
		ShipmentDate,
		ShipmentNumber,
		Note,
		ETLExecutionID,
		InvoiceNumber,
		SourceSystemId)) ~> WritetoTarget
